item.title: Blake chasing American dream through Blackburn Rovers Sports College
item.description: Through Blackburn Rovers Sports College, Blake is working towards achieving his dream of studying in the United States after joining the Level Three Sports Diploma five months ago. Delivered by Blackburn Rovers Community Trust, the official charity of Blackburn Rovers, the Sports College was recommended to 16-year-old Blake by a friend who had previously attended.
